package.description: OpenJazz is a free, open-source version of the classic Jazz Jackrabbit™ games.

en-US.description: OpenJazz is a free, open-source version of the classic Jazz Jackrabbit™ games.
en-US.longDescription: OpenJazz is a free, open-source version of the classic Jazz Jackrabbit™ games. OpenJazz can be compiled on a wide range of operating systems, including Windows 98/Me/XP and Linux. To play, you will need the files from one of the original games.
en-US.name: OpenJazz
